`abstract class ChartNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.chart` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ChartNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/chart/ChartNode.java)

Base class of a chart that shows named series of values over the labels of an X axis.

![A line chart of one series from Mon to Fri](/captures/catalog-nodes-chartnode.webp)

## Description

A chart draws nothing by itself: a subclass draws its data, and the chart computes the bounds of the scale.
It waits until it has data and every series has a value, drawing its skeleton meanwhile.

- [Charts](/use/learn/going-further/charts/)

## Creation details

<a id="ChartNode-constructor"></a>

### ChartNode

`ChartNode(double x, double y, double width, double height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Called by a subclass with the position and the size of the chart.
The chart throws an `IllegalStateException` when it is attached without an X axis or a Y axis.
